title: Chainlink Launches CustodySync With Anchorage Digital
why_it_matters: The product targets a practical barrier to institutional DeFi lending: synchronizing collateral balances, pricing and loan events while a regulated custodian retains control of the assets.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

Chainlink Launches CustodySync With Anchorage Digital

Chainlink introduced CustodySync with Anchorage Digital as launch partner to coordinate custodied collateral with DeFi lending systems without moving client assets out of qualified custody.
